def feats2(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    def gmin(r):
        idx=[c for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]=='G']
        return min(idx) if idx else None
    nn=[(r,c) for r in range(50,60) for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]=='N']
    gapn=[(r,c) for r in range(40,44) for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]=='N']
    def bbox(pts):
        if not pts: return None
        cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        return (min(cs),max(cs))
    return {'up':gmin(10),'mid':gmin(30),'low':gmin(50),'objN':bbox(nn),'gapN':bbox(gapn)}
